title: 6.5.26 Save System: Build Save/Load with Slots
description: Graded: build a game with a complete save system, at least 3 save slots, load functionality, auto-save on level complete, and a Continue option on the title screen.

steps.title: Set up the game world
steps.instructions: Inside setup(), create a canvas, a player sprite, and a way to earn points (collectible sprites or a score counter that increases over time). This is the game that players will save and load.
hints: Open the moSHion docs drawer and find the Canvas and Sprite sections.

steps.title: Implement save slots
steps.instructions: Create at least three save slots using storeItem with different keys (e.g. 'saveSlot1', 'saveSlot2', 'saveSlot3'). Build a save object that contains the player's position, score, and level. Use JSON.stringify before calling storeItem.
hints: See 6.5.17 (Three Save Slots) for save slot patterns.
The save object should look like { x: player.x, y: player.y, score: score, level: level }.

steps.title: Implement load functionality
steps.instructions: Add a way to load from each slot. Call getItem with a slot key, parse the result with JSON.parse, and apply the loaded values back to the player position, score, and level. Provide a fallback (|| {}) in case a slot is empty.
hints: See 6.5.17 (Three Save Slots) for loading from save slots.
Use JSON.parse(getItem('saveSlot1')) || null to handle empty slots.

steps.title: Add auto-save on level complete
steps.instructions: Add a goal zone or score threshold. When the player reaches it, auto-save to a dedicated slot (e.g. 'autoSave') in addition to incrementing the level. The auto-save should happen automatically: no button press required.
hints: See 6.5.25 Worked Example for the auto-save pattern.
Check for overlap or score >= threshold to trigger the auto-save.

steps.title: Add a title screen with Continue option
steps.instructions: Build a simple title screen state at the top of draw(). Show the game title and a prompt like 'Press C to Continue'. When the player presses C, load the most recent auto-save. Provide a way to start a new game as well.
hints: See 6.5.20 (Title Screen Detects Existing Saves) for title screen patterns.
The Continue option should check if an autoSave exists before offering to load it.

requirements.title: Canvas exists
requirements.description: A canvas is created when the sketch starts.

requirements.title: storeItem used
requirements.description: storeItem is called at least once to save data to localStorage.

requirements.title: getItem used
requirements.description: getItem is called at least once to read data from localStorage.

requirements.title: JSON.stringify used
requirements.description: JSON.stringify is used to serialize save data before storing.

requirements.title: JSON.parse used
requirements.description: JSON.parse is used to deserialize save data after loading.
